subject: MAP: transfer acceptance instructions and limited-use terms (Retaillytics pilot)
messages:
From: Elena Park <elena.park@retaillytics.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-07-21T09:14:00-07:00
Subject: Pilot data transfer + MAP kickoff

Ben — thanks again for the demo last week. Retaillytics is ready to move forward with the 6-week pilot and we need a short mutual action plan so our legal/procurement teams can sign off.

High-level ask: we will provide a small evaluation corpus (sample CSV + prompt pack) for Redwood to ingest in your hosted sandbox. Use constraints: ephemeral access, no downstream training, retain for 90 days from receipt, and provide audit logs for token usage.

Attached: Retaillytics_eval_manifest.csv (manifest of files + labels) — I can share procurement contact if you need the PO/MA.

Next steps we need from Redwood:
- Draft MAP with deliverables, acceptance gate, and deletion timeline
- Sandbox credentials (ephemeral) and test endpoint details
- Security appendix: SOC2 evidence pointers we can share with procurement

Can you draft the MAP and share a one-page acceptance checklist by EOD tomorrow? Procurement contact: procurement@retaillytics.com.

Thanks,
Elena Park
Head of ML Ops, Retaillytics
elena.park@retaillytics.com

--
Attachment: Retaillytics_eval_manifest.csv (stub)

From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
To: Elena Park <elena.park@retaillytics.com>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-07-21T11:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot data transfer + MAP kickoff

Elena — great to hear, and thanks for the clear asks.

I've sketched a short MAP and attached a PDF with the acceptance checklist and operational notes (Redwood_MAP_Draft_20270721.pdf). Summary below:

1) Deliverables
  - Retaillytics evaluation corpus ingested to Redwood sandbox (read-only lane)
  - Prompt pack sample loaded and scoped to ephemeral run (no persistent artifacts)
  - One smoke test run and acceptance report (functional criteria)

2) Acceptance gates
  - Functional acceptance: smoke test pass (3 sample queries)
  - Security acceptance: verify access policy + KMS integration in sandbox
  - Legal acceptance: mutual signature on 1-page MAP and limited-use clause

3) Data handling & retention
  - Retention: 90 days after ingestion by default; production/persistent retention requires separate contract
  - No downstream training: explicit prohibition in MAP; artifacts deleted on takedown schedule
  - Audit logs: we will provide per-request token counts and request IDs for the pilot window

4) Operational notes
  - We provide ephemeral sandbox credentials valid for up to 14 days per token; tokens rotate automatically
  - Promptpack sample will be delivered as a zip; Redwood will not persist promptpack contents after acceptance unless explicitly approved

5) Timeline (proposed)
  - 7/22: Redwood sends MAP draft (attached) and provisioning instructions
  - 7/23: Retaillytics returns signed MAP or redlines
  - 7/24–7/26: Ingest + smoke test window
  - 8/23: Default takedown (90 days) unless extended

I attached the MAP draft and a small promptpack sample placeholder. Procurement notes — loop procurement@retaillytics.com for the PO.

If that matches, can Marissa help coordinate the onboarding runbook and Karthik will handle the sandbox provisioning details.

Ben Carter
Sr. Account Executive, Redwood Inference
ben@redwood.com

--
Attachment: Redwood_MAP_Draft_20270721.pdf (stub); Attachment: promptpack_sample_v1.zip (stub)

From: Elena Park <elena.park@retaillytics.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@retaillytics.com, Devon Hale <devon.hale@retaillytics.com>
Date: 2027-07-22T08:47:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot data transfer + MAP kickoff

Ben — thanks for the quick turnaround and the clear MAP. A couple of asks from procurement and legal before we can sign:

- Retention: procurement is asking to shorten to 60 days for the pilot and to include an explicit audit clause that we can request deletion confirmation in writing.
- Data categories: we need a brief line in the MAP that confirms no PII leaves our dataset and that any fields marked PII in the manifest are redacted prior to transfer (we will redact but want that clause).
- Can you add a one-line statement that Redwood will provide a CSV of per-request logs (request_id, timestamp, token_count, model) on request within 7 days?

I've attached procurement's basic PO template (sent separately to procurement@redwood.com). If you can incorporate the three bullets as redlines, procurement is ready to sign quickly.

On the timeline: 7/23 sign sounds fine if we can get the 60-day retention baked in.

Best,
Elena

--

From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
To: Elena Park <elena.park@retaillytics.com>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, procurement@retaillytics.com
Date: 2027-07-23T16:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot data transfer + MAP kickoff — updated redlines

Elena / team — thanks for the notes. Per internal review and Karthik's provisioning checklist, we've accepted the three redlines with these clarifications: 

- Retention: agreed to 60 days for the pilot. MAP will state: "Redwood will delete all evaluation artifacts 60 days after ingestion; Retaillytics may request deletion confirmation in writing and Redwood will provide deletion receipts."
- PII: added clause that only pre-redacted data will be ingested; Redwood to refuse any dataset that contains unredacted PII flagged in the manifest. We will include a short manifest-validation step prior to ingest.
- Audit logs: Redwood will produce a per-request CSV with request_id, timestamp, token_count, and model for any date range within the pilot window; Redwood will deliver within 7 business days of request.

Operational / security additions:
- Ephemeral tokens: tokens will be valid up to 14 days and will auto-rotate; long-lived tokens for debug can be issued to named engineers with approval.
- Sandbox KMS: we will surface SOC2 section references and a short checklist to satisfy procurement; full SOC2 package provided under NDA (we can work with procurement on that).
- Acceptance window: smoke test to complete within 48 hours of ingest. If acceptance fails we will agree a single remediation sprint up to 5 business days.

Next steps:
- I attached an updated MAP PDF with the three redlines incorporated (Redwood_MAP_Draft_20270723.pdf) and a short one-page acceptance checklist.
- Marissa will open a provisioning ticket for the sandbox (expected ETA 7/24 morning).
- Procurement: when you confirm, please send the PO to procurement@redwood.com and we'll route it to finance for onboarding.

If that looks good we'll mark the MAP as mutually accepted once we have the procurement PO and signature on the one-page MAP.

Ben Carter
Sr. Account Executive, Redwood Inference
ben@redwood.com

--
